translate_en|mods/Take A Bath And Shower: Open the bath action radial menu.
Press Up to confirm the selected action.
Polish your bathtub to make it white and clean.
Disassemble the shower parts from the bathtub.
Electricity is required for hot water!
Remove the tub stopper to drain the water.
The drain pan will be made thinner and improved to allow it to be placed facing north or west.
Install the shower on the bathtub.
If the tub does not contain enough water, you will miss some bath benefits.
Not enough water to fill the tub!
You need to insert the stopper to fill the tub with water.
Cannot re-equip because some items are too far away.
Discard the saved pre-bath equipment data without re-equipping.
Re-equip the clothes and held items that were saved before bathing or showering.
You need to remove the stopper and drain the tub first!
It can only be reverted in a south- or east-facing shower.
Revert your shower to old model.
Revert your bathtub to old model.
Remove the shower parts and pack them up.
Disassemble and take out the shower parts. The drain pan will be destroyed.
Upgrade wall shower to shower with drain pan.
Once added, it cannot be changed until the bathtub is emptied of water.

If you proceed, the shower will start without you changing clothes. 
If you need to change clothes, please restart from the outside. 
Do you want to continue?

Whether to consider all fluid types when check for fluid containers plumbed into baths and showers. If disabled, only fluid containers containing water will be considered.
This checkbox option does nothing itself.
The chance of body shampoo spawning.
The chance of bath salt spawning.
Blood And Dirt To Grime Multiplier

A multiplier on how amount blood and dirt over the threshold will accumulate as grime. <LINE> This is calculated by total blood or dirt stains on full body, not by part, and the maximum value is 1, not 100. <LINE> If you set this value to 3, you will accumulate 1.5 additional grime every hour if you have 50 blood on your body.
If there is more blood on your body than this value, it will accumulate on the body as Grime.
The base amount of Grime that accumulates for your body every hour without you doing anything.
This checkbox option does nothing itself.
If there is more dirt on your body than this value, it will accumulate on the body as Grime.
Disable the increased stress caused by someone (includ zombies) seen at you while bathing.
Disable the increase discomfort, boredom, and unhappiness that comes from bathing with wearing clothes or in bad condition bathwater (wrong temperature or dirty).
Displays a moodle that increases in severity for every 25 Body Grime accumulated. <LINE> <PUSHRGB:1,0.5,0.5> It will not work if Moodle Framework Mod is not installed!<POPRGB>
Enable Body Grime functions. If this to False, all settings below this will be disabled.
If you have electricity, you can reheat the bath water.
This checkbox option does nothing itself.
If you have too much Grime, you will feel discomfort.
If you have too much Grime, you will feel a slight noxious smell.

This is the amount of water remaining in the shower faucet after a water outage. <LINE> By making this value higher than the amount of taking shower water consumed, you will be able to take a shower in the first house you visit after the water outage.

This is the amount of water remaining in the bathtub faucet after a water outage. <LINE> By making this value higher than the amount of taking bath water consumed, you will be able to take a bath in the first house you visit after the water outage.
The amount of water needed to take a shower.
This checkbox option does nothing itself.
If you placed bathtub to outdoors, you can collect rainwater. But you cannot use that water for plumbing.

The amount of water that can be stored in a bathtub.
Note: This is separate from the amount of water remaining in the faucet when shut out of the water supply.
When you bathing, the water becomes tainted by the dirt washed off your body.
Water Consumption Multiplier When Washing In Bath

The amount of water consumed when washing blood, dirt, and grime from your body during a bath. This is a relative value based on the total amount removed. If you want to disable water consumption, set it to 0.
Amount of grime removed in Vanilla Wash Self.

Whether has a water temperature concept to shower and bath.
If False, you will no longer be able to get the warming to body effects of hot water or the stress relief effects.
Use it as soap in the shower.
Unpack it to place a wall shower.
If you have a bath towel in your inventory, it will automatically dry your self after bathing.

Turning this off will prevent automatic changing of clothes before and after bathing. <LINE> That like a hardcore mode, meaning you can bathe with clothes on. <LINE> Note: Bathing with clothes on can help remove dirt and blood from clothes, but the downside may be greater.

Bathing will automatically exit after you have taked for the set amount of time. If auto dry and auto clothes change are turned on, everything will be done automatically. <LINE> You can switch from automatic to manual during your bathing, but not the other way around.
You can choose the menu to display when you select (right-click) the bathtub.
Whether to display the option to improve the bathtub and shower in the context menu.
Whether a special tooltip is displayed when you move the mouse over the bathtub.
Tub Water Dirty Level As Number
Display the dirty level in the tub water as a number.

If this true, only the hot shower menu will be displayed if hot water is available, if hot water is not available only the cold shower menu will be displayed. <LINE> if this false, both will always be displayed.

For multiplayer games. Enter the names of users you don't mind being seen bathing. If DisableFeelingStressByGaze is set to True in your sandbox settings, nothing will happen. <LINE> This is a username, not a character name. If there are multiple names, separate them with a comma (,). <LINE> (Example: Bob Smith,kate,Si-Cafe)
Drops all equipped items on the ground.
Drops any items attached from hotbar.
Drops any items equipped on your back. (backpacks or weapons etc.)
Drops clothing items you were wearing.
Drops equipped container items. (Such as backpack, fanny packs and satchels.)

Any items weighing more than this amount will be dropped. <LINE> The weight is the actual weight, not the equipped weight. <LINE> This is calculated separately from the above drop options. 0 means do nothing.
These options work when Auto Clothes Change is enabled. <LINE> "Not Take Off XXX" option is takes precedence.
Enables steam animations in hot shower. It has almost no impact on FPS, but you can turn it off if you don't need it.
Whether to exclude various accessories except watches when auto changing clothes.
Whether to exclude equipment that provides attachments such as belts and slings when auto changing clothes. <LINE> However, this is limited to items whose weight is 0.5 or less.
Whether to exclude such as glasses and eye-patch when auto changing clothes.
Whether to exclude watches when auto changing clothes.

This is only available to solo games or server administrators, but not recommended in MP. <LINE> This will remove all Tub Fluid Container Objects in the world. <LINE> This may be useful if your performance suffers because you're left with many filled bathtub on tons locations that you've forgotten about in the world.
Skip Warning When Already in a Bathing Area
When enabled, the warning that bathing will start without changing clothes is not displayed when you are already in a bathtub or shower.

Action time for changing clothes before and after the bath. This does not apply to hand items.
Fast = slightly faster overall. OneAction = changes all clothes in one action. Vanilla = normal speed.
